detailedProcess.title: Initial Consultation
detailedProcess.description: We start with a conversation about your project, priorities, and vision — in person, by phone, or over WhatsApp.

detailedProcess.description: We discuss functional needs, storage requirements, style preferences, and an indicative budget range.

detailedProcess.title: Site Measurement
detailedProcess.description: Our team visits your home or site in Lahore to record precise measurements and note structural details.

detailedProcess.title: Design Planning
detailedProcess.description: We prepare layouts and design concepts tailored to your space, reviewing options together until the plan feels right.

detailedProcess.title: Material & Finish Selection
detailedProcess.description: You choose from boards, laminates, veneers, painted finishes, hardware, and countertop combinations.

detailedProcess.title: Quotation
detailedProcess.description: We share a clear, itemised estimate based on the finalised design, materials, and scope of work.

detailedProcess.title: Production
detailedProcess.description: Approved designs move into production, where components are carefully manufactured to specification.

detailedProcess.title: Quality Inspection
detailedProcess.description: Every component is checked for finish, alignment, and durability before it leaves the workshop.

detailedProcess.title: Installation
detailedProcess.description: Our installation team fits the work on-site with care taken to protect your home throughout.

detailedProcess.title: Final Handover
detailedProcess.description: We walk through the completed project together and address any final adjustments before handover.

faqs.q: How long does a custom kitchen project usually take?
faqs.a: Timelines depend on the scope of design, material availability, and site readiness. We share an estimated schedule after the design and material selection stage.

faqs.q: Do you visit our home for measurements?
faqs.a: Yes. After the initial consultation, our team visits the site in Lahore to take accurate measurements before finalising the design.

faqs.q: Can I choose my own countertop and hardware?
faqs.a: Yes. We guide you through available material, finish, and hardware options so the final selection matches your preferences and budget.

faqs.q: Do you work with interior designers and architects?
faqs.a: Yes, we regularly collaborate with designers and architects to execute kitchen and woodwork elements within a wider interior scheme.

faqs.q: Can wardrobes be designed for irregular room shapes?
faqs.a: Yes. Wardrobes are measured and designed around your room's actual dimensions, including alcoves, slopes, and awkward corners.

faqs.q: What internal storage options are available?
faqs.a: Drawers, adjustable shelving, hanging rails, shoe racks, and accessory trays can be planned according to your storage needs.

faqs.q: Can I combine sliding and hinged sections?
faqs.a: Yes, hybrid layouts are possible depending on the room layout and your storage priorities.

hero.heading: Custom Kitchens & Complete Home Woodwork
hero.text: Beautifully designed, precisely crafted, and built around the way you live.

intro.heading: Crafted Around Your Space. Designed Around Your Life.
intro.description: We create custom kitchens, wardrobes, and complete woodwork solutions that combine thoughtful design, practical functionality, and refined craftsmanship. Every project is tailored to the client’s space, lifestyle, and aesthetic.

testimonials.heading: What Our Clients Say
testimonials.note: Sample placeholder testimonials shown for illustration — not verified reviews.

hero.heading: Thoughtful Design. Reliable Craftsmanship.
hero.description: A Lahore-based studio dedicated to custom kitchens, wardrobes, and complete home woodwork.

intro.heading: A Studio Built Around Considered Woodwork
intro.description: [Editable placeholder] Our studio designs and builds custom kitchens, wardrobes, and complete home woodwork for homeowners across Lahore. We work closely with each client — from first conversation to final installation — to create spaces that are both beautiful and genuinely functional.
intro.secondary: [Editable placeholder] Whether you are building a new home, renovating an existing one, or furnishing a single room, our approach stays the same: understand the space, plan around how it will be used, and execute with care.

approach.heading: How We Think About Every Project

points.title: Craftsmanship Philosophy
points.description: We believe good woodwork is judged in the details — clean joinery, consistent finishes, and hardware that performs quietly for years. Every project is approached with the same level of care, regardless of scale.

points.title: Design & Functionality
points.description: Beautiful design should also work hard for the way you actually live. We plan layouts around daily routines — how you cook, store, dress, and relax — before finalising any aesthetic direction.

points.title: Quality & Attention to Detail
points.description: From board selection to the final alignment of a cabinet door, our team reviews work at each stage so that the finished result feels considered and precise.

points.title: Customization Process
points.description: Nothing is off-the-shelf. Each kitchen, wardrobe, or woodwork element is designed from your space’s actual measurements, structural constraints, and personal preferences.

points.title: Professional Execution
points.description: Our team manages the process from consultation through to installation, keeping communication clear and the site tidy and respected throughout.

area.heading: Serving Lahore & Nearby Areas
area.description: We currently take on projects across {serviceArea}. Whether you are locally based or planning a home from overseas, we coordinate site visits, measurements, and installation to fit your schedule.
area.secondary: [Editable placeholder] For overseas clients building or renovating a home in Lahore, we can coordinate consultations remotely and schedule site visits and installation around your availability.
